title: Publicly indexed and Wayback-archived Dream Journal data for 9spaceking
retrieval_method: Search-engine index snippets for publicly accessible Dream Journal pages
scope: Best-effort partial backup combining search-indexed text, archived profile excerpts, and archived dream-list metadata.
limitations: Direct page fetches of dreamjournal.net failed in this environment, so page content below was transcribed from indexed result snippets.
Some records are full-text as represented in the snippet; others are title-only or excerpts. Each record has a content_status field.
Search snippets may omit, truncate, normalize, or stale-cache text and dates. A null date means no reliable full date was exposed.
The site homepage and profile archive snippets gave inconsistent dates or archive counters in places; conflicting observations are retained rather than silently reconciled.
This file includes only publicly indexed material. No login, private endpoint, or access-control bypass was used.
The Internet Archive preserved public profile/list pages, but tested individual dream-page URLs were not captured; archive excerpts therefore remain incomplete.
An archived 2022 full-dream-list snapshot is available in 28 text chunks. This backup transcribes chunks 0 and 1 (146 metadata rows); the remaining 26 chunks are not transcribed.
An archived May 2023 profile snapshot displayed pagination up to page 201. This suggests a much larger journal than the search engine index exposes, but does not establish an exact entry count.

entries.title: Doki Doki Jimmy Neutron Club
entries.author: 9spaceking
entries.date_confidence: day and month only; year not reliably exposed
entries.source_type: individual public dream page, indexed snippet
entries.content: I am in a strange area where I am being chased by Jimmy Neutron who is to my right, with a bunch of people behind me. I run to a rocket ship and try to outmaneuver him, although there is suddenly randomly a dangerous darkroom that chases me and in third person view I must move wooden doors and obstacles out of the way. I narrowly make it to the end, although even then it is difficult to convince Jimmy to see reason. Eventually though, I succeed, and the fragments of the dream piece together. A song plays seemingly sang by Monika from Doki Doki Literature Club, although it is not "Your Reality". As I wake up, I find that my music I left on to a "calm music" accidentally autoplayed to another song. I misidentify it as "demons", while it is actually "You can be king again".
entries.additional_author_text: The music I was playing while I was asleep was "fireflies", which might have reminded me a bit of Jimmy Neutron's theme.
entries.notes: The source snippet showed the aside about waking music with italics; formatting is represented as plain text here.

I look for another girl who looks like my soul mate, though she leaves before I am able to do so.

entries.title: Reckless Driving
entries.author: 9spaceking
entries.date_text: 10 Jan; page indexed with date Wednesday, January 10, 2024
entries.date_confidence: high
entries.source_type: individual public dream page, indexed snippet
entries.content: I recklessly drive toward a building in my mom's car. (In real life my mom has never let me drive her car) The speed is never revealed but I switch past solid line lanes and one time even immediately switch out of a right-turn only lane without even looking at my mirrors, resulting in the car in the "new lane" incredibly close behind me, clearly displaying my recklessness. When we finally get there, it is a building with marble staircases and looking quite grand, similar to the Columbia University library (the old library). We then plan to go back, except my mom has someone different; he drives even MORE recklessly than me, taking a short-cut having two "holes". My eyes are very tired in the dream and I struggle to keep them open, since I don't want the holes to surprise me. We finally reach our destination, but a very crafty clever blond-haired woman, inferred to be our target, merely coldly remarks: "You went past two holes to get here, didn't you." The man who drove and I were quite shocked-- "How did you know?!"

entries.title: Interesting Game Against Mother
entries.author: 9spaceking
entries.date_confidence: day and month only; year not reliably exposed
entries.source_type: individual public dream page, indexed snippet
entries.content: I am with my mother in what looks to be a smaller boxing arena, with all the ropes on the side. It seems that the goal of the game is to knock the other person out of the arena "through any means possible". I first test out the waters, using only hand-to-hand techniques, but finding my mother far more experienced she manages to beat me multiple times. Next up, I then consider drawing a sword with my left hand (dominant hand within dreams), but do not want to reveal my secret so early on since I would only have one chance at it. To conceal this, I pretend that I am miming the fight, seeing how it would play out, and conclude that it would be risky even to use my dominant hand. Instead, I draw my right sword with my right hand and flip it over, bouncing off of my mother's left arm. I am mildly surprised and think over what to do. I consider a last resort of using "table turn" followed by my trump card "22" which usually can warp reality to efficiently do anything not combat related within only 22 seconds, although both do not fit this situation, since I am not being threatened, nor is 22 good against combat. I step back and use the rubber of the boundary to gain momentum and push myself forward, however, the friction of the floor is too great and abruptly stops me. I think over other strategies over how I might beat my mother in this game.

entries.title: Final SCP-682 Termination Log
entries.author: 9spaceking
entries.date_text: 27 May; page indexed as Tuesday, May 27, 2025
entries.date_confidence: high
entries.source_type: individual public dream page, indexed snippet
entries.content: Item: G*_______*, an asain male of 19 years old, 5'5" tall and wearing casual clothing, with physics-violating powers. Previously unexposed to SCP's. Tissue Test Record: The carcass of SCP-682. Termination Test Record: This event could only be viewed from the point of view of the subject, regardless of attempts to do so otherwise. In addition, the subject's thoughts were able to be heard through the entirety. Following the events of [DATA EXPUNGED], subject appeared in a grey-wall building of dimensions __m x __m x __m, higher than ten stories tall. A young male child appeared close to him to his left, interpreted as his "child", but unclear whether is an actual offspring. In addition, a red light was clearly visible near the top of the left to his view. Subject approached SCP-682, near-death, surrounded by flies and corroded by bacteria, under unknown circumstances. Subject used his major power, which he named "Path to Victory", able to lead him to the best outcome in any situation. He ignored SCP-682 and led the young male child upwards through numerous stairs. At a crucial separating branch, he suddenly thought to teach the child a lesson instead, still using his ability. With his right hand, subject releases a light saber of red color. It is reported that, far faster than an eye blink, in only 0.373 or 0.376 milliseconds, the light saber grows, boring an incredibly large hole in SCP-682, approximately 1/4 to 1/3 of its body, leading subject to declare SCP-682 permanently dead. After subject teaches this lesson about being careful to the child, he exits.
